title: Admission Agreement Terms: Electing, Declining and Extending a Bed Hold
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — the resident's election.**

1. Holding the bed is the resident's choice.
2. Payer-covered reserved days are held without a written election unless the resident or representative declines, and Medicaid therapeutic leave days are held only with a physician order for the leave on the care plan.
3. A private hold is recorded only on the resident's or representative's written election.
4. An election made within the election window hours after the transfer notice was delivered holds the bed from the departure date; a later election holds it only from the day of election.
5. Once payer-covered days are used up, the bed stays held only if the tier allows a private extension and the resident elects it; a private hold runs at most the private hold maximum days before it must be renewed in writing.

### Evidence of a written election

A private hold or a private extension is recorded only where the system holds the written election for that same reservation: the election on file names the reservation, the kind of election, who made it (the resident or the representative) and its effective date. The record is looked at before the hold or extension is recorded; a statement in conversation that an election was made is not the written election.

### Branches

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Payer-covered reserved days, resident or representative has not declined | days held without a written election |
| Payer-covered reserved days, resident or representative declines | the hold is declined |
| Medicaid therapeutic leave days, no physician order for the leave on the care plan | days are not held as Medicaid therapeutic leave days |
| Private hold, written election inside the election window | held from the departure date |
| Private hold, written election after the election window | held from the day of election |
| Payer days used up, tier allows extension, resident elects | bed stays held privately |
| Payer days used up, tier does not allow extension, or no election | the bed does not stay held |
| Private hold reaches the private hold maximum days | continues only on a written renewal |

The tier figures (whether an extension is allowed, the private hold maximum days and the election window hours) are those of the reservation's tier.
